ryan (Revenue): Heads up - during deferred schedule reconciliation I found a $92,750 variance tied to NebulaCompute INV-99321. The vendor invoiced a customer-level volume rebate but the billing pipeline converted the line to an immediate revenue reduction instead of a liability/deferred contra. Need revrec decision for month close. cc katy, henry

billing-bot: Vendor invoice uploaded: INV-99321 (NebulaCompute). Amount: $92,750. Posted 2026-04-01 11:03 UTC.

katy (Billing): I pulled the event. The invoice line came through as type=volume_rebate; our rules translate that to contra-revenue when issued as a customer credit. For vendor-originated rebates tied to future hosting commitments we should treat as deferred reduction to revenue (deferred contra) and amort over contract term (9 months per contract).

henry (Controller): Do we have any of it posted already? If system applied it as contra-revenue, we need reversal + deferred booking.

ryan (Revenue): System auto-applied $15,000 as contra-rev in the draft close. Remaining $77,750 is still in suspense. Proposed treatment: reverse the $15k and create a deferred contra of $92,750 amortized over 9 months => monthly ~ $10,305.56.

katy (Billing): Proposed JE to reverse and establish deferral:

```
Journal - April 2026
Dr Contra-Revenue 15,000
Cr Accounts Payable 15,000 
Memo: Reverse auto-applied contra for INV-99321 (mis-class)

Journal - April 2026 (establish deferral)
Dr Accounts Payable 92,750
Cr Deferred Contra-Revenue 92,750
Memo: Record vendor rebate as deferred contra (NebulaCompute INV-99321) amort 9 months
```

henry (Controller): For audit I need: invoice PDF, billing event export, mapping snapshot effective at invoice time, and contract confirming 9-month amort. Also please document why this should be deferred vs immediate credit.

ryan (Revenue): Uploading docs now: https://files.redwood/INV-99321.pdf, billing export: https://files.redwood/billing/99321-export.csv, mapping snapshot: https://docs.redwood/pricing/mapping-2026-03-30. Contract: NC-2177 confirms 9-month rebate amortization. Short rationale added to workpaper: vendor rebate tied to future hosting commitments -> economic benefit spread over contract period.

katy (Billing): I'll open a mapping change to treat vendor.volume_rebate + vendor=NebulaCompute + sku contains "commit" => deferred_contra. PR link will be in the workpaper. Workpaper: WP-INV-99321-nebula.

sylvia (CFO): Reviewed backup and approve the reversing JE + deferral establishment. Please route all docs and JE to accounting@redwood.com and cc me. Also, add a controls ticket to ensure vendor rebate mappings are validated during billing cutoffs.

henry (Controller): Approved contingent on attachments (received). Posting JE tonight and will update the deferred schedule and close pack. I'll tag the workpaper and include PR link.

ryan (Revenue): Thanks — I'll run a 180-day scan for other vendor rebates that might be misclassified and post results here tomorrow.

katy (Billing): Quick scan returned 2 potential cases; will attach a CSV to WP for review.

ryan (Revenue): Great, closing loop. We'll monitor PR + controls follow-up.
